meta.title: Model Access
meta.description: Bring your own free-tier accounts into DeepSeek Harness: log in once and the models of fifteen channels (CodeArts, CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy, LobsterAI, Qoder, TRAE, Cline, Loomy, Raccoon, MiniMax, ZCode, Gemini, OfficeAce, Accio Work) appear in the picker, with a token dashboard, a per-request log and a local OpenAI-compatible gateway.
